{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify completed orders with missing revenue
non_numeric_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'].isna())]

# Check the distribution of 'revenue' for completed orders with valid data
completed_with_revenue = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'].notna())]

# Compute the mean revenue for completed orders with valid revenue
mean_valid_revenue = completed_with_revenue['revenue'].mean()

# Compute the mean revenue for all completed orders (including those with missing revenue)
# Since missing values are NaN, mean() will automatically exclude them
mean_all_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']['revenue'].mean()

# Check if the missing revenue values are systematically different
# Compare the distribution of customer_age, customer_segment, and channel between missing and non-missing completed orders
missing_stats = non_numeric_completed[['customer_age', 'customer_segment', 'channel']].describe()
valid_stats = completed_with_revenue[['customer_age', 'customer_segment', 'channel']].describe()

# Compute differences in means
age_diff = missing_stats.loc['mean', 'customer_age'] - valid_stats.loc['mean', 'customer_age']
segment_diff = len(non_numeric_completed[non_numeric_completed['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']) - len(completed_with_revenue[completed_with_revenue['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'])
channel_diff = len(non_numeric_completed[non_numeric_completed['channel'] == 'email']) - len(completed_with_revenue[completed_with_revenue['channel'] == 'email'])

mean_valid_revenue, mean_all_completed, age_diff, segment_diff, channel_diff"}
